notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
Features

[list]
[*] Achievements for reaching more complex waves of enemies
[*] Stats to show which Power-Ups you have used throughout your playthroughs
[*] High Score is saved as a stat as well to show off how good you are at the game :)
[/list]

Tweaks

[list]
[*] The game now runs in x64 instead of x86 due to Steamworks requiring it
[/list]
